Package com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client.impl.grid

Class DataSliceGrid

java.lang.Object
com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client.impl.grid.DataSliceGrid
All Implemented Interfaces:
Grid<DataSliceGrid.Cell>, PovGrid<DataSliceGrid.Cell>
public class DataSliceGrid extends Object implements PovGrid<DataSliceGrid.Cell>
A PovGrid view over a DataSlice, exposing its POV, top axis, left axis, and data cells as a two-dimensional grid.

    • getTopRows

      public int getTopRows()
      Returns the number of rows in the "top" or "columns" axis. In other words, this is the count of the number of dimensions in the top region of the returned grid (below the POV), which will always be at least 1.

      number of rows in the "top" axis
